# Next Level Construct, LLC

> Licensed general contractor based in Essington, Delaware County, Pennsylvania, serving Pennsylvania, Delaware and South Jersey. Phone (215) 980-0195. Rated 5.0 on Google from 15 reviews.

Licenses: PA HIC #PA201433, DE #2026700487, NJ HIC #13VH14325000. Fully insured. Family-run, with over 50 years in the trade. Free written estimates.

## Main services
- [Windows and doors](https://www.next-level-construct.com/windows-and-doors.html): replacement windows, entry doors, sliding patio doors, storm doors
- [Decks and railings](https://www.next-level-construct.com/decks.html): new decks, rebuilds, composite decking, railing replacement
- [Deck permit guide](https://www.next-level-construct.com/deck-permits-guide.html): deck and porch permit, zoning, stormwater, impervious-surface and historic-review rules by township in Delaware County and the Main Line PA, South Jersey and New Castle County DE
- [Basement finishing](https://www.next-level-construct.com/basements.html): framing, insulation, drywall, egress windows, trim; permitted and inspected
- [Basement finishing guide](https://www.next-level-construct.com/basement-finishing-guide.html): basement finishing permit, egress window, smoke alarm, fire-blocking and ejector-pump rules by township in Delaware County and the Main Line PA, South Jersey and New Castle County DE
- [Historic district windows and doors guide](https://www.next-level-construct.com/historic-windows-doors-guide.html): HARB, HPC and Certificate of Appropriateness rules for replacing windows, doors and porches by town in Delaware County and the Main Line PA, South Jersey and New Castle County DE
- [Kitchen remodeling](https://www.next-level-construct.com/kitchens.html): cabinets, counters, tile, trim, layout changes
- [Bathroom remodeling](https://www.next-level-construct.com/bathrooms.html): waterproofed showers, tile, vanities, fixtures, ventilation
- [Additions and dormers](https://www.next-level-construct.com/additions.html): room additions, dormers, porch roofs, zoning and permits
- [All services](https://www.next-level-construct.com/services.html): kitchens, bathrooms, additions, whole-home and basement remodeling, finish carpentry, siding, HOA exterior work
